entry.title: New: Resolution 241 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO MALAMA O PUNA

Approves a grant of $53,200 to Malama O Puna, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization to provide land stewardship and cultural education for the Waiʻele, Puna property, (Tax Map Keys: 1-4-003:003 and 037), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawai‘i County Charter.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 241-23 & LAAC-32 - 10/04/23
